text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ruling Islamists back down from their pledge to lift a ban on the wearing of the Islamic headscarf.
- Twenty-one people are injured in fire at Turkey's biggest oil tanker in Tuzla dockyard at Istanbul.
- Head of Turkish armed forces, Gen. Ismail Hakki Karadayi, will visit Israel by the end of this month.
- Ten people, including a former mayor, are arrested for "provocation" in an anti-Israel protest held by Islamist town council.
- Repentant Kurdistan Workers Party rebels are being used as hitmen by the state and are being paid by the slush fund of the emergency rule governor
- Fifty-two organisations will hold an anti-Islamist protest at the weekend in Ankara.
- Tobbaco producers that price for product is being raised by 100 percent.
- Former head of the army shuns the possibility of any coup in future as there will be a strong reaction from outside world.
